## Documentation area

Which README section, in-app Help topic, wiki page, setup step, or message needs improvement?

## What is unclear or incorrect?

Describe the problem and, when possible, quote only the short phrase that needs correction.

## Suggested improvement

What information would have made the task easier to complete?

## Environment or version

Note the UPM version and whether you were using the Electron desktop app or browser dashboard if that affects the documentation.
